description: Automatically detect and redact Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from text. Replaces emails, phone numbers, SSNs, credit cards, IP addresses, and JWT tokens with [REDACTED_TYPE] placeholders. Safe to use before logging or sending to an LLM.

types.description: Comma-separated types to redact (default: all). Options: email, phone, ssn, credit_card, ip_address, jwt

name: redact_pii
